confidence_notes: Food anchors (beer, coffee, meals) rest on aggregated, partly crowdsourced guide and cost-of-living figures that disagree with each other, so they are bounded estimates. Cocktail and wine are weak: they come from Japanese city averages and a beer-relative basis, not direct Matsuyama data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The JPY/USD conversion used for the food figures is roughly 150-155 yen per dollar and is an assumption.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized Japanese regional city, cheaper than Tokyo and Sendai, with prices set against Japanese regional averages (Takamatsu, Okayama and similar). Cocktail and wine use a local price relationship to beer, with cocktails about 1.5 times beer and wine about 1.5 times beer, because direct Matsuyama data was weak.
